name: ArgoCDApp
description: Get status, sync, wait, diff or refresh Argo CD applications over the Argo CD REST API.
author: WayneGoosen

groups.name: waiting
groups.visibleRule: command = sync || command = wait || command = rollback

inputs.name: connection
inputs.label: Argo CD service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: The Argo CD server and token to use. Prefer a project role token scoped to a single AppProject.

inputs.name: command
inputs.label: Command

options.get: get - report sync and health status
options.diff: diff - show desired vs live state
options.refresh: refresh - refresh from Git, then report status
options.rollback: rollback - roll back to a previous revision
options.action: action - run a resource action (e.g. restart)
options.manifests: manifests - render desired or live manifests
options.create: create - create or upsert from a manifest file
options.set: set - change deployment fields on the live spec

inputs.helpMarkDown: Which Argo CD application operation to run.

inputs.name: applications
inputs.label: Applications
inputs.helpMarkDown: One application per line. Use `name` or `namespace/name` for applications in any namespace. Leave empty when using a selector.

inputs.name: selector
inputs.label: Label selector
inputs.helpMarkDown: Kubernetes label selector matching several applications, e.g. `app.kubernetes.io/instance=my-app`. Used when Applications is empty.

inputs.name: project
inputs.label: Project
inputs.helpMarkDown: The AppProject the applications belong to. **Strongly recommended**: without it Argo CD reports a missing application and an RBAC denial identically, as 'permission denied'.

inputs.name: appNamespace
inputs.label: Application namespace
inputs.helpMarkDown: Namespace holding the Application resources, for app-in-any-namespace installs. Defaults to the Argo CD control plane namespace.

inputs.name: resource
inputs.label: Resource
inputs.helpMarkDown: Target resource as `KIND:NAME`, `GROUP:KIND:NAME` or `GROUP:KIND:NAME:NAMESPACE`, for example `apps:Deployment:payments-api`. Required for `action`; optional for `logs`, where omitting it streams every pod in the application.

inputs.name: revision
inputs.label: Revision
inputs.helpMarkDown: Git revision, tag or Helm chart version to sync to. Defaults to the application's target revision.

inputs.name: dryRun
inputs.label: Dry run
inputs.helpMarkDown: Preview the sync without applying it. Waiting is skipped automatically for a dry run.

inputs.name: force
inputs.label: Force
inputs.helpMarkDown: Use `kubectl apply --force`. Replaces resources that cannot be patched.

inputs.name: resources
inputs.label: Resources
inputs.helpMarkDown: Sync only these resources, one per line, as `KIND:NAME`, `GROUP:KIND:NAME` or `GROUP:KIND:NAME:NAMESPACE`.

inputs.name: syncOptions
inputs.label: Sync options
inputs.helpMarkDown: One option per line, e.g. `CreateNamespace=true`, `ServerSideApply=true`, `Replace=true`.

inputs.name: retryLimit
inputs.label: Retry limit
inputs.helpMarkDown: How many times Argo CD itself retries a failed sync. 0 disables retries.

inputs.name: onRunningOperation
inputs.label: If an operation is already running

options.wait: wait - wait for it to finish, then sync

inputs.name: wait
inputs.label: Wait for the sync to converge

inputs.name: waitFor
inputs.label: Wait for
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comma-separated conditions that must all hold: `sync`, `health`, `operation`, `suspended`.

inputs.name: failOnTimeout
inputs.label: Fail the task on timeout
inputs.helpMarkDown: When off, a timeout reports 'succeeded with issues' instead of failing.

inputs.name: refresh
inputs.label: Refresh
inputs.helpMarkDown: A refresh blocks until the Argo CD controller has reconciled, so it can take noticeably longer than a plain read.

inputs.name: hard
inputs.label: Hard refresh
inputs.helpMarkDown: Also regenerate manifests from the source repository, ignoring the manifest cache.

inputs.name: failOnHealth
inputs.label: Fail on health statuses
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comma-separated health statuses that fail the task.

inputs.name: failOnOutOfSync
inputs.label: Fail when out of sync
inputs.helpMarkDown: When off, an out-of-sync application reports 'succeeded with issues'.

inputs.name: failOnDiff
inputs.label: Fail when differences are found
inputs.helpMarkDown: When off, differences report 'succeeded with issues'. Useful as a pull request gate.

inputs.name: publishSummary
inputs.label: Publish a run summary
inputs.helpMarkDown: Publish an application table, unhealthy resources and any diff to the pipeline run summary.

inputs.name: historyId
inputs.label: History ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: History ID to roll back to, or `previous` for the deployment before the current one. Run the `history` command to list IDs.

inputs.name: action
inputs.label: Action
inputs.helpMarkDown: Action to run, for example `restart`. **Leave empty to list the actions available on the resource.**

inputs.name: actionParameters
inputs.label: Action parameters
inputs.helpMarkDown: One `name=value` per line. Argo CD exposes only parameter names, so values are passed through as strings.

inputs.name: manifestSource
inputs.label: Manifest source

options.git: git - desired state rendered from the source
options.live: live - current state in the cluster

inputs.helpMarkDown: Note a revision can only be rendered from `git`; live state has no revision to select.

inputs.name: podName
inputs.label: Pod name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Read logs from one pod. Leave empty to stream every pod in the application, interleaved.

inputs.name: tailLines
inputs.label: Tail lines
inputs.helpMarkDown: Lines to read from the end of each stream. Applied per pod, not overall.

inputs.name: previous
inputs.label: Previous container instance
inputs.helpMarkDown: Read logs from the previous instance of the container, for diagnosing a crash loop.

inputs.name: logFilter
inputs.label: Filter
inputs.helpMarkDown: Only lines containing this text. Prefix with `!` to invert the match.

inputs.name: artifactName
inputs.label: Artifact name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the published pipeline artifact. Defaults to `argocd-manifests` or `argocd-logs`.

inputs.name: manifestFile
inputs.label: Manifest file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to an Application manifest. YAML or JSON; multi-document YAML is supported, so an app-of-apps bootstrap file works in one step.

inputs.name: upsert
inputs.label: Upsert
inputs.helpMarkDown: Update the application if it already exists. Note this additionally requires `update` RBAC, not just `create`.

inputs.name: validate
inputs.label: Validate
inputs.visibleRule: command = create || command = set || command = unset
inputs.helpMarkDown: Ask Argo CD to validate the application against its repository and destination before storing it.

inputs.name: helmParameters
inputs.label: Helm parameters
inputs.helpMarkDown: One `name=value` per line; existing parameters with the same name are replaced. For **unset**, pass names only.

inputs.name: helmStringParameters
inputs.label: Helm string parameters
inputs.helpMarkDown: As above, but forces the value to be treated as a string (`--helm-set-string`).

inputs.name: helmValueFiles
inputs.label: Helm value files
inputs.helpMarkDown: One per line. **Replaces the whole list** rather than appending, matching `argocd app set --values`. For **unset**, the listed files are removed.

inputs.name: kustomizeImages
inputs.label: Kustomize images
inputs.helpMarkDown: One per line as `name:tag`, `old=new:tag` or `name@sha256:...`. Images sharing a name replace one another. For **unset**, pass names only.

inputs.name: targetRevision
inputs.label: Target revision
inputs.helpMarkDown: Pin the source to a branch, tag, commit or chart version.

inputs.name: sourcePosition
inputs.label: Source position
inputs.helpMarkDown: For multi-source applications, which source to edit, **numbered from 1**. Required when an application has more than one source.

inputs.name: confirm
inputs.label: Confirm deletion
inputs.helpMarkDown: **Required.** Deleting an Argo CD application also deletes the resources it manages. Label selectors are not accepted for delete — name each application explicitly.

inputs.name: cascade
inputs.label: Cascade
inputs.helpMarkDown: Also delete the resources the application manages. Turning this off leaves them running.

inputs.name: propagationPolicy
inputs.label: Propagation policy
inputs.helpMarkDown: Kubernetes deletion propagation. Cannot be combined with cascade disabled.

outputVariables.name: syncStatus
outputVariables.description: Sync status of the application (single-application runs).

outputVariables.name: healthStatus
outputVariables.description: Health status of the application (single-application runs).

outputVariables.name: revision
outputVariables.description: Revision the application is running.

outputVariables.name: operationPhase
outputVariables.description: Phase of the most recent operation.

outputVariables.name: operationMessage
outputVariables.description: Message from the most recent operation.

outputVariables.name: appUrl
outputVariables.description: Deep link to the application in the Argo CD UI.

outputVariables.name: appsJson
outputVariables.description: JSON array of every application acted on, with sync, health and revision.

outputVariables.name: hasDiff
outputVariables.description: true when the diff command found differences.

outputVariables.name: diffResourceCount
outputVariables.description: Number of resources that differ from the desired state.

outputVariables.name: latestHistoryId
outputVariables.description: Newest deployment history ID (history command).

outputVariables.name: rolledBackTo
outputVariables.description: History ID the application was rolled back to.

outputVariables.name: availableActions
outputVariables.description: Comma-separated resource actions available (action command with no action set).

outputVariables.name: manifestCount
outputVariables.description: Number of manifests rendered.

outputVariables.name: manifestFile
outputVariables.description: Path to the rendered manifest file.

outputVariables.name: logLineCount
outputVariables.description: Number of log lines collected.

outputVariables.name: logFile
outputVariables.description: Path to the collected log file.

outputVariables.name: terminatedCount
outputVariables.description: Number of operations terminated.

outputVariables.name: appName
outputVariables.description: Name of the application created (single-application create).

outputVariables.name: createdCount
outputVariables.description: Number of applications created or upserted.

outputVariables.name: deletedCount
outputVariables.description: Number of applications whose deletion was requested.
